title: Members of the Boozan Kings and Harmon Henderson
summary: He names the boys in his childhood group and remembers friend Harmon Henderson, who died young.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: I wonder if we could get the name of some of the different guys in your Boozang, King, Boozang,

and I was Joe Francis' Uncle Zoo. Russell on little makeshift drums. Myself, and Harmon Henderson, who was a terrific ukulele player. Played a little piano. His mother was a midwife and he went to school and, real educated little kid. Well raised. But they were trying to raise him like a mama's boy. Did all the housewaves, he had to cook while his mother's father was away. And I sneaked him up in the district a couple of times, played with us. Mother found out what would have made him quit the group. She wanted to be a doctor or something. So when I went to Pensacola, I bought a New Orleans paper in Pensacola, just casual, and looked in the paper and saw Louisiana Weekly one of them. I saw that Harmon Henderson had died of appendicitis, you know. And he was a brilliant kid. He had his own Ford, he was about 6, 17 now. He had his own Ford car, which his dad had bought him. And he had to fix the motor up himself. He could sing, he could dance, he could play, and he was very, very serious kid. And we were real tight buddies. In fact, he showed me the ukulele. I played really good. Did any of the others go on to fame? No, none of them. Joe Francis, actually, he played, became a great ukulele up there. I tried to get him a gift out there, because he had a terrific beat. But he never was interested in it. The Russell was drifted off from the drums. I see him now, you know, after I go home, and I see him over there visit me, or I'll visit me. They'll talk about how great it was, how successful I'd been. I've gone to New York to play a cab Callaway, you know, the usual I was a kid, you know, the child, you know, the one of them kids up there to cut a dance from the child. That's one of them. One of them, as far as I was.
